title: Increase model depth (DEPTH=10)
description: Changed DEPTH from 8 to 10 layers; model scales to 768 dim, 6 heads via ASPECT_RATIO=64
reflection: Depth increase regressed performance: 1.001233 vs baseline 0.996598 (-0.0046 bpb). Despite scaling law intuition, deeper models may need more training steps to converge. 5-minute budget insufficient for 25% larger model. First attempt (DEPTH=12) caused OOM; fallback to DEPTH=10 still underperformed. This suggests width-over-depth may be better for time-limited compute in this regime.
